hook: delude 是騙你，deluge 是淹你，divulge 是洩漏——工作室三個噴嘴：謊言、洪水、祕密。
script: delude＝欺騙。deluge＝洪水／大量湧來。divulge＝洩露。保全：別被騙、別被淹、別爆料。形近對決：先分清語意軸，再對號入座。登場：delude（謊言噴）、deluge（洪水閥）、divulge（祕密閥）、flood（洪水）、secret（祕密）、leak（洩漏）。

members.speakLineEn: False headlines can delude readers into believing an easy miracle cure.
members.speakLineZh: 不實標題可能欺騙讀者，讓他們相信簡單的神奇療法。

members.speakLineEn: A sudden deluge flooded the subway stairs within minutes.
members.speakLineZh: 突如其來的大洪水在幾分鐘內淹沒地鐵階梯。

related.synonyms: flood, inundation, torrent, downpour, cloudburst, waterspout

members.speakLineEn: Reporters refused to divulge the identity of their confidential source.
members.speakLineZh: 記者拒絕泄露機密消息來源的身分。

related.synonyms: unwrap, disclose, reveal, discover, expose, break
related.antonyms: wrap, cover, conform to, keep, make, promote, repair

members.speakLineEn: Sandbags lined the riverbank as the spring flood rose overnight.
members.speakLineZh: 春汛連夜上漲時，河岸堆起一排沙袋。

members.speakLineEn: They kept the surprise party a secret until she walked through the door.
members.speakLineZh: 他們把驚喜派對當成祕密，直到她推門進來。

members.speakLineEn: A roof leak stained the classroom ceiling after days of heavy rain.
members.speakLineZh: 連日大雨後，屋頂洩漏把教室天花板染上水漬。

members.speakLineEn: The firefighter adjusted the hose nozzle before aiming at the flames.
members.speakLineZh: 消防隊員調整水帶噴嘴後，才對準火燄射水。

members.speakLineEn: Art students shared a crowded studio filled with half-finished canvases.
members.speakLineZh: 美術系學生共用一間堆滿半成品畫布的擁擠工作室。

members.speakLineEn: Witnesses finally told the truth about what happened on the bridge.
members.speakLineZh: 目擊者終於說出橋上事件的真相。

members.speakLineEn: The fire alarm pulled everyone out of the dorm into the courtyard.
members.speakLineZh: 火警警報把所有人從宿舍趕到中庭。

reviewHooks: 三詞 de-/di- 開頭易混
